iti49:1.1: II.) Vuttaṃ hetaṃ bhagavatā vuttamarahatā ti me sutaṃ.
iti49:2.1: Dvīhi bhikkhave diṭṭhi-gatehi pariyuṭṭhitā devamanussā oliyanti eke atidhāvanti eke cakkhumanto ca passanti.
iti49:3.1: Kathañca bhikkhave oliyanti eke? Bhavārāmā bhikkhave devamanussā bhavaratā bhavasammuditā, tesaṃ bhavanirodhāya dhamme desiyamāne cittaṃ na pakkhandati na pasīdati na santiṭṭhati nādhimuccati, evaṃ kho bhikkhave oliyanti eke.
iti49:4.1: Kathañca bhikkhave atidhāvanti eke? Bhaveneva kho paneke aṭṭiyamānā harāyamānā jigucchamānā vibhavaṃ abhinandanti. Yato kira bho ayaṃ attho kāyassa bhedā param-maraṇā ucchijjati vinassati na hoti param-maraṇā, etaṃ santaṃ etaṃ paṇītaṃ etaṃ yathāvan-ti, evaṃ kho bhikkhave atidhāvanti eke.
iti49:5.1: Kathañca bhikkhave cakkhumanto passanti? Idha bhikkhu bhūtaṃ bhūtato passati, bhūtaṃ bhūtato disvā bhūtassa nibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya paṭipanno hoti, evaṃ kho bhikkhave cakkhumanto passantīti. Etam-atthaṃ bhagavā avoca, tatthetaṃ iti vuccati:
iti49:6.1: {Yo} bhūtaṃ bhūtato disvā bhūtassa ca atikkamaṃ | yathābhūte {vimuccati} bhavataṇhāparikkhayā ||
iti49:7.1: {Sa ve} bhūtapariñño so vītataṇho bhavābhave | bhūtassa vibhavā bhikkhu nāgacchati punabbhavan-ti ||
iti49:8.1: Ayam-pi attho vutto bhagavatā iti me sutan-ti ||12|| Dukanipātaṃ niṭṭhitaṃ. Tassuddānaṃ:
iti49:9.0: Dve indriyā (28,29) dve tapanīyā (30,31) sīlena apare duve (32,33) | anottappī kuhanā dve ca (35,36) saṃvejanīyena te dasa ||
iti49:10.1: vitakkā desanā vijjā paññā dhammena pañcamaṃ | ajātaṃ dhātu sallānaṃ sikkhā jāgariyena ca | apāya diṭṭhiyā ceva bāvīsati pakāsitā ti || [Tikanipāto.] (Tik. I.)
